## Automated Tests Required

### TEST-01 - First EditMode tests
**Target paths**:
- `tests/EditMode/Card/`
- `tests/EditMode/Character/`
- `tests/EditMode/Role/`

**Minimum scenarios to cover**:
- Round-state sequencing in the card/turn flow
- HP-based hand-size limit from the Role system
- Tag add/remove/refresh behavior on roles

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Zero or empty-hand state
- Minimum HP / hand limit boundary
- Removing tags until count reaches zero

**Estimated test count**: 3-6 initial EditMode tests

## Manual QA Checklist

### Documentation Review
- [ ] `design/gdd/systems-index.md` statuses are valid exact strings and no row contains parenthetical notes
- [ ] Every GDD in `design/gdd/` contains the required 8 sections plus a `Status` field
- [ ] Every ADR in `Docs/architecture/` contains `Status`, `Date`, `Engine Compatibility`, `ADR Dependencies`, `GDD Requirements Addressed`, and `Performance Implications`
- [ ] `production/project-stage-report.md` matches the current repository state after preparation work

### Test Scaffold Review
- [ ] `tests/README.md` explains how this repository expects tests to be organized
- [ ] `.github/workflows/tests.yml` exists and clearly notes the `UNITY_LICENSE` requirement
- [ ] `tests/smoke/critical-paths.md` reflects current game entry paths and core battle flow

## Smoke Test Scope

1. Project opens with Unity 2022 LTS/Tuanjie-compatible editor settings intact
2. Login scene can be identified as an entry point artifact
3. Battle scene assets and scripts remain present after documentation changes
4. Test scaffold files exist at the expected repository paths
5. No workflow file under `.claude/` was modified during preparation

---

## Playtest Requirements

No playtest sessions are required for Sprint 01 unless documentation changes trigger runtime code changes. If runtime test work begins during the sprint, add a short manual battle-flow walkthrough and capture evidence under `tests/evidence/`.
